City.why: One row per city keyed by ID with name, district and population, pointing at Country; Country.Capital points at it.

Country.why: One row per country keyed by Code with continent, area, population, GNP and government; City and CountryLanguage point at it.

CountryLanguage.why: Links countries to the languages spoken there, with official flag and share; the language is a code with no table of its own, as in Mondial's language and imdb's genres.
